681-1315-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1315-6621-8345.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat from step 2.

6662-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6662-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a 2/2 green Bird creature token with its own landfall ability
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6772-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6772-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2511-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

4067-7308-7890.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

requires.n: Aura Costing One Mana that Enchants Creatures

3560-3953-4050--163.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with the Aura attached, adding one mana of any color.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling the Aura and allowing you to cast it until your next turn.
Cast the Aura from exile by paying its mana cost, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When the Aura enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

57-4235-4460-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4460-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

6351-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

955-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
955-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-6720.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3767-3918-5116-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1358-1978-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1358-1978-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Sydri.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3652-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1306-1987-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-2438-5220-6634.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3617-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3617-3976.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Time Walk and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Time Walk without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1486-1651-6837.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Three Tree Mascot and another artifact, targeting Three Tree Mascot.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Three Tree Mascot.
Repeat.

736-4056-4679--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Copy Enchantment. Choose to have Copy Enchantment enter the battlefield as a copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature. Then, untap Yenna and scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.
736-4056-4679--82.notes: If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2793-3017-3743-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3743-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

542-5733-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
542-5733-6333.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

1247-4137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Blossom-Clad Werewolf's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3152-5125-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga has power 4 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
3152-5125-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R} or {G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spell with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, causing you to untap Helga.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sparkcaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1661-5078-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
1661-5078-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

3705-3771-4050-5997.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3705-3771-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1692-3662-4377.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
1692-3662-4377.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.
1692-3662-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color you have devotion to.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-4306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

618-2007-2217.description:
Cast Thermal Flux for {U} targeting Kiki-Jiki, making it a snow permanent.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Rime Tender with haste.
Tap the Rime Tender token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.
